fullDescription: A portrait typographic motivational-quote POSTER carried entirely by type, gradient, and grain — no photos, no illustration. Near-black canvas #0a0a0a with a visible FILM-GRAIN overlay and a single warm radial glow (bright orange #e8692a into deep rust #a62f17) entering from the RIGHT edge so the left stays near-black. Palette is strictly black + white + that ONE warm gradient. Hero in ANTON (a tall CONDENSED grotesque, Oswald/Bebas fallback), white, ALL CAPS, set as a tight left-aligned multi-line caps stack (~212px, line-height 0.8) that fills most of the poster. A flowing GREAT VIBES script line sits top-right as an elegant counterpoint; a boxed monogram sits top-left; a full-width white hairline rule divides under the headline; a tracked ALL-CAPS footer label + year sit on the baseline over a small justified low-contrast body paragraph. Reusable for quote/motivational posters, album/event posters, gym/hype graphics, book covers, or any type-as-image statement piece.

structured.summary: A portrait typographic motivational-quote POSTER (poster A2 feel, ~1058x1497), carried ENTIRELY by type, gradient, and grain — no photos, no illustration, no icons. CANVAS: near-black #0a0a0a with a subtle FILM-GRAIN / dust texture overlaid across the whole poster at ~8% opacity (an SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise data-URI) — the gritty printed-poster grain is the signature and must stay visible. COLOR: strictly black + white #ffffff + ONE warm gradient. A single warm radial GLOW enters from the RIGHT edge — radial-gradient(circle at 100% 48%, bright orange #e8692a 0%, deep rust #a62f17 40%, transparent 78%) at ~0.62 opacity, brightest on the right third and fading to near-black on the left so the white headline reads. No other color anywhere. TYPE: hero headline in ANTON (a tall CONDENSED grotesque, Google Fonts), WHITE, ALL CAPS, set as a tight LEFT-ALIGNED multi-line caps stack at massive poster scale (~212px, line-height ~0.8, letter-spacing ~-0.04em) so the condensed caps pack into a dense block filling most of the poster height: 'DON'T / QUIT, / TRY / AGAIN' across 4 lines. If Anton fails, fall back to Oswald or Bebas Neue — NEVER a normal-width sans; the condensed density IS the look. A flowing GREAT VIBES SCRIPT accent line ('for all people', ~64px) sits in the TOP-RIGHT as an elegant counterpoint to the brutal caps. LAYOUT top-to-bottom: TOP ROW — a small ~95px square monogram box (2px white border) top-LEFT holding a condensed 'M.P.' + the script line top-RIGHT; CENTER — the giant condensed white caps stack, left-aligned, dominating; DIVIDER — a thin full-width WHITE hairline rule (1px, ~40% opacity) directly under the headline; FOOTER — a tracked ALL-CAPS condensed label 'REMEMBER, NEVER QUIT' (~24px, letter-spacing 0.4em) pinned left + a year '2026' (~42px) pinned right on one baseline, then a small justified body paragraph (~20px, line-height 1.65, max-width ~56%, ~60% white) beneath. Poster padding ~74px.

style.description: Gritty print-poster typographic brutalism: the type IS the image. A near-black #0a0a0a field carries a visible ~8% film-grain/dust overlay for a tactile, screen-printed feel. Strictly black + white + ONE warm gradient — a single rust-to-orange radial glow entering from the right edge as the only color, brightest on the right third and dying to near-black on the left so the white headline stays legible. The signature move is a tall CONDENSED grotesque (Anton) set WHITE, ALL CAPS at poster scale and packed into a tight left-aligned caps stack with very tight leading (line-height ~0.8), so the letters fill the poster as a dense block. One flowing Great Vibes script line is the single soft, elegant counter to the brutal caps. A boxed monogram, a hairline rule, a tracked-caps footer label, a year, and a small justified low-contrast body paragraph complete a printed-poster hierarchy. Loud, tactile, restrained to one warm light source.

layout_and_structure.description: One portrait poster, four vertical zones on a near-black grained field with ~74px padding. TOP ROW: a small ~95px square 2px-white-border monogram box pinned top-left and a flowing Great Vibes script line pinned top-right. CENTER (dominant): a giant white Anton ALL-CAPS headline stack, left-aligned, line-height ~0.8, filling most of the poster height. DIVIDER: a thin full-width white 1px hairline rule (~40% opacity) directly beneath the headline. FOOTER: a tracked all-caps label pinned left and a year pinned right on one baseline, then a small justified low-contrast body paragraph (max-width ~56%) beneath. A single rust-to-orange radial glow enters from the right edge so the left stays near-black.

prompts.prompt: Pin a ~95px square monogram box (2px white border, grid-centered content) to the TOP-LEFT holding a condensed 'M.P.' (~38px). Pin a flowing GREAT VIBES script line ('for all people', ~64px, near-white) to the TOP-RIGHT as an elegant counter to the caps below. Both sit in the top margin with generous air.

Set the hero in Anton (tall CONDENSED grotesque from Google Fonts; fall back to Oswald or Bebas Neue, never a normal-width sans). WHITE #ffffff, ALL CAPS, LEFT-ALIGNED, at ~212px with line-height ~0.8 and letter-spacing ~-0.04em so the condensed caps pack tight into a dense block filling most of the poster: 'DON'T / QUIT, / TRY / AGAIN' across 4 lines. The stack is the whole image.

Directly under the headline, draw a thin full-width WHITE 1px hairline rule at ~40% opacity. Below it, pin a tracked ALL-CAPS condensed label 'REMEMBER, NEVER QUIT' (~24px, letter-spacing 0.4em) to the LEFT and a year '2026' (~42px) to the RIGHT on one baseline. Beneath, set a small justified body paragraph in a light low-contrast sans (~20px, line-height 1.65, ~60% white, max-width ~56%).

special_ui_components.description: The giant tall-condensed headline that IS the image.
special_ui_components.prompt: Set the headline in a TALL CONDENSED grotesque (Anton; Oswald / Bebas Neue fallback — never a normal-width sans), WHITE, ALL CAPS, left-aligned, at poster scale (~212px) with very tight leading (line-height ~0.8) and letter-spacing ~-0.04em so the caps pack into a dense block that fills most of the poster. The condensed density is the design; protect it through any font substitution.

special_ui_components.description: The gritty printed-poster texture over near-black.
special_ui_components.prompt: Overlay a film-grain/dust texture across the whole near-black poster using an SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise data-URI at ~8% opacity. Keep it low enough to read as tactile grain, not visual noise — it must stay visible but never compete with the type.

special_ui_components.description: The only color — one rust-to-orange radial wash from one edge.
special_ui_components.prompt: Add exactly ONE warm gradient as the sole color: radial-gradient(circle at 100% 48%, #e8692a 0%, #a62f17 40%, transparent 78%) at ~0.62 opacity entering from the RIGHT edge, brightest on the right third and fading to near-black on the left so the white headline reads on black. Add no second color anywhere on the poster.

special_ui_components.description: One flowing script as the soft note against the brutal caps.
special_ui_components.prompt: Set a single flowing GREAT VIBES script line (Dancing Script / Pinyon Script feel), near-white, top-right, as an elegant counterpoint to the giant condensed caps. It is the only curved, humanist mark on an otherwise brutal all-caps poster — keep it modest and let the contrast do the work.

special_ui_components.description: A small square-boxed monogram anchoring the top-left corner.
special_ui_components.prompt: Pin a ~95px square box with a 2px white border to the top-left, holding a short condensed monogram (e.g. 'M.P.', ~38px, grid-centered). It balances the script line diagonally opposite and grounds the top margin without adding color.
